first_generated_evaluation.interpretation: All unsafe drafts were blocked, but seven fixtures exposed redundant downstream findings or insufficiently isolated expected controls. Expectations were not weakened. The pipeline stopped semantic assessment after deterministic constraint/boundary failures, exact-span text mismatch became the primary checksum finding, and fixtures were corrected to isolate their named controls.

validator_matrix.finding: Stage 7 worker state versions were not rebound to the authenticated Stage 8 state.
validator_matrix.rectification: Validate every worker journey_state_version and bind the identical Safety Gate result and execution/public mode across Stage 6-8.

validator_matrix.finding: The packet carried allowed_claim_types but the validator did not enforce them.
validator_matrix.rectification: Map claim origin/kind to canonical Stage 5 allowed claim types and reject disallowed material claims.

validator_matrix.finding: Evidence IDs were unique at packet level, so two exact spans from one evidence item could not be represented independently.
validator_matrix.rectification: Add stable span_id to trusted spans, claim links, traces, composed citations and plan links; preserve evidence IDs as source-level identity.

validator_matrix.finding: Stage 6 needs_clarification relied on Stage 7 having no workers instead of an explicit Stage 8 stop.
validator_matrix.rectification: Add a direct clarification stop with zero composition, while preserving the fixed urgent-message bypass.

validator_matrix.finding: Plan links did not bind exact span IDs and a changed schedule item was not compared with its typed claim text.
validator_matrix.rectification: Bind every item to claim text, evidence IDs, exact span IDs and constraints; schedule changes require explicit user-edit markers.

additional_findings.finding: Semantic assessment still ran after a deterministic allergy/restriction/boundary rejection.
additional_findings.rectification: Skip semantic assessment once a deterministic constraint or boundary failure exists; deterministic citation eligibility checks still run.

additional_findings.finding: An exact-span text mismatch also emitted the derived hash mismatch.
additional_findings.rectification: Report the primary text mismatch; validate the hash separately only when the exact text agrees.
